retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast summer lifestyle layout featuring a central figure against a tropical backdrop with heavy, layered 3D display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in swimwear and sunglasses stands against a bright tropical background of palm trees and blue sky, framed by large, multi-layered 3D metallic text and secondary informational blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically between large foreground text and background palms
Warm skin tones and gold text contrasting against cool blue sky and water
Heavy horizontal text blocks anchoring the bottom third of the composition
Diagonal palm fronds framing the upper corners
coreInvariants: Three-dimensional extruded display text with metallic gradients
Tropical beach setting with visible palm fronds
Central human subject in summer attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot of a female figure, scaled to occupy the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, 3D 'PURE URBAN' text block in the lower-middle section.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header, moves down to the central figure, then to the large 3D title, and finally to the detailed tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the composition is densely packed with text and imagery, using the sky as the only open area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan and sky blue in the background and water.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold and orange gradients in the primary 3D typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary metadata and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high brightness, typical of summer-themed commercial art.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy block weights with wide proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to the point of touching or overlapping
Outer glow and drop shadows used to separate text from the busy background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display type paired with clean, wide geometric sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular call-out box with blue gradient

preserve: Extended width of the main title
avoid: Thin or light weights for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, urban aesthetic of the 2000s.
Provides the necessary weight for the 3D extrusion effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A sun-drenched tropical beach scene with palm trees in the corners, a clear blue sky with a lens flare, and a central figure in sunglasses and swimwear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D extruded gold text in the center-bottom, and clean white extended sans-serif text at the very top and bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text 3D and metallic?
Are the palm trees framing the top corners?
Is the color palette dominated by cyan and gold?
Is the secondary text extended and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Density of the palm tree framing
mustRedesign: Branded logos or specific trademarked icons
Exact facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text has a clear light source consistent with the background.
Check that the palm trees do not obscure the main title.
Verify that the white metadata text is legible against the background.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a commercial music product.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key tropical lifestyle photo with heavy, 3D-extruded extended sans-serif typography in a gold-on-blue color scheme.
